lxc_e3ea79617b463df8.text: You have five questions: how to pay, how to get to the city, what to see, how to check in and what to eat.

lxc_435773dc06c774b5.text: In this simulation, you take each step in time order.

lxc_456a2a6a479d836b.text: You learn real prices and real times.

lxc_c9b72c9fde828389.text: You also practise simple English for each step.

lxc_86752e148e768e31.text: You land at Vilnius International Airport.

lxc_734c7303a6af6112.text: This airport is the main airport for Vilnius.

lxc_3c622a6b525dd8b5.text: You walk with the other people to passport control.

lxc_e6916075f63c5c40.text: An officer looks at your passport.

lxc_5cf229d939a08960.text: Prices in Vilnius are in euros (€).

lxc_0240df36600804b5.text: For example, a bus ticket from the airport to the city centre costs €1.

lxc_9573417896df9e0f.text: You buy this bus ticket from the driver.

lxc_731c758be86516d5.text: So it is good to have your payment ready before you get on the bus.

lxc_a8bf99d3f8e80a3d.text: You need maps and the Bolt app.

lxc_8ce97304447518b2.text: So you look for a SIM card.

lxc_96a8403c21f7167b.text: You do not know the price yet.

lxc_388e1265c2d3a7a6.text: Ask at the shop before you buy.

lxc_e9ec739e2d489164.text: You have three good ways to get to the city.

lxc_ab1c43d6ab99b104.text: Each way has a different time and price.

lxc_eadf81ac8c56de9c.text: The first way is the train.

lxc_a2a9cdab0c5a5bc3.text: The train goes from the airport to the central railway station.

lxc_e61698d8fc741f8e.text: A ticket costs €0.45, and you can buy it online.

lxc_07c02078a3d6ac29.text: This train is fast and cheap.

lxc_2fa2212124a803c4.text: But it runs only 16 times a day.

lxc_fc6ec58af39f6944.text: So check the next train time first.

lxc_d2faf2a82e34a367.text: The second way is the bus.

lxc_68dc8ff333bca113.text: The bus takes about 15 minutes to the city centre.

lxc_540c37f1f2809e6a.text: Several buses go to the city centre and the Old Town.

lxc_1b5534ee415b9964.text: You can buy a €1 ticket from the driver.

lxc_34953f5373e87d3d.text: City tickets cost €1 for 30 minutes or €1.25 for 60 minutes.

lxc_bc318f1d49857783.text: The third way is a taxi or a ride app.

lxc_35cc8b255b87e4a0.text: A taxi from the airport to Cathedral Square in the Old Town costs about €10.

lxc_913116f4fd57c095.text: You find taxis at the arrivals area.

lxc_41576148897ae08f.text: Bolt is a big ride company in Vilnius.

lxc_1743e8031956edc7.text: Bolt and Uber work 24 hours a day, every day.

lxc_b27bc7483c6e8052.text: Open the app and check the price before you say yes.

lxc_57ef2775c7a1742c.text: You walk into Vilnius Old Town.

lxc_0c794576a8511e39.text: The Old Town is very old.

lxc_d405b3582b6b05af.text: Many of its streets and buildings are hundreds of years old.

lxc_31deff051d971098.text: It is one of the largest old towns in Northern Europe.

lxc_e74bf4b8dda38343.text: So you see many small streets and many old buildings.

lxc_eaa0bc30160ed1a6.text: The other is Town Hall Square.

lxc_5fa58082b2e7252a.text: You also see the buildings of Vilnius University.

lxc_28a345ec088b940d.text: They are a famous part of the Old Town.

lxc_ed15db219ea350ce.text: Then you see the Gate of Dawn.

lxc_2886528a5c07671c.text: This is an important old gate.

lxc_f85b3d2ef8f96f07.text: It was part of the city wall.

lxc_442acc530506a15a.text: Later, people took down most of the city walls.

lxc_f982bdeafd5b4e77.text: It has a famous picture of the Virgin Mary.

lxc_534fc7e810ac59d3.text: Many people come here to pray.

lxc_bde5e2af58fdef19.text: The church services are in Lithuanian and Polish.

lxc_0b8c4537d09ba0d7.text: You go to the front desk.

lxc_af827c6784a0415e.text: The staff member gives you a key card.

lxc_9e645118fb134724.text: You are new in Vilnius, so ask for help.

lxc_e7bb7d16b038701b.text: The front desk is a good place for questions.

lxc_f2465050122b16bd.text: Ask for the way to Cathedral Square or Town Hall Square.

lxc_c99d44d88635e42c.text: These are big squares in the Old Town, so they are easy places to meet people or start a walk.

lxc_3bea34c3b5b9a2a0.text: You can ask about food too.

lxc_ff7de227408390a6.text: You go to a restaurant near your hotel.

lxc_14dbc3dca9c9af79.text: You see two famous Lithuanian dishes.

lxc_d51fe402c963c2d0.text: They are big potato dumplings, often with meat inside.

lxc_8d34ddd37f559b4f.text: They come with a sour cream sauce and small bits of bacon or pork rind.

lxc_c9589206865fb260.text: This is a warm, heavy meal.

lxc_728dd32fa553f407.text: It is good after a long trip.

lxc_be1805832dcc7ea6.text: This is a cold soup, and it is bright pink.

lxc_5515b1935990e860.text: It has boiled and cooled beetroot, cucumber, green onion, dill and other herbs.

lxc_5395e505faa9d58a.text: The beetroot gives it the pink colour.

lxc_08a503e71a867a76.text: People in Vilnius love this soup.

lxc_d2c57c9ada396a99.text: Since 2023, Vilnius has a festival for this soup every year.

lxc_62a9025703cb0a0f.text: The menu shows the prices in euros.

lxc_9306036278255479.text: Read the price before you order.

lxc_839ecadf014aa6e4.text: You have your bag, and you are at the arrivals area of Vilnius Airport.

lxc_f9e68a3526544d6f.text: Your hotel is in the Old Town.

lxc_ec19013a2d88776a.text: Your goal is to choose a ride to the Old Town and learn the time, the price and where to buy a ticket.

lxc_ffb399f5c9c78461.text: You walk through the Old Town and arrive at your hotel.

lxc_ae10d8a11ff8aea3.text: Your goal is to check in, get help with your phone and ask about food and the way to Town Hall Square.

lxc_d3079ea56428c960.text: You find the restaurant near your hotel.

lxc_048235fa9b61fc3d.text: It is warm and busy inside.

lxc_fbb251ea9f3e28f7.text: A server named Eglė gives you a menu.

lxc_b5776ada69f09d24.text: Your goal is to ask about the dishes, order your meal and pay.

lxc_6940372f90db59db.text: Tell the story of your first day in Vilnius.

lxc_b49216bb2615787a.text: Start at the airport and end at dinner.

lxc_dddfa21cd9a518d9.text: Choose the train, the bus or a taxi, and say the time and the price.

lxc_bd21b77caebf9599.text: Say one thing about the Old Town or the Gate of Dawn.

lxc_916ffd237d2851af.text: Your partner asks two questions, for example "Why do you choose the bus?" and "What is in the soup?"
